title: Beginner Jazz Dance Class I Warm up & Technique Tutorial

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher is encouraging and thorough, guiding students step-by-step through a structured warm-up. She provides detailed technical feedback while her assistant demonstrates.

safety: Feel free to shift side to side if you need to
Use your elbows to push those knees back

quotes.text: Today I'm bringing you a 30-minute beginner jazz class.
Let's start with a good warm-up.
You want to make sure you have a flat back there.
Instead of rounding over, the more elongated the stretch, the deeper the stretch you're going to get.
